hook: A secret camera crew at a 2000 wedding destroyed the friendship between two famous chefs.

sections.voiceover: A secret camera crew at a 2000 wedding destroyed the friendship between two famous chefs.
Gordon Ramsay spent 3 years as a protégé at Harveys, a London restaurant owned by Marco Pierre White. But what actually caused their legendary fallout?
However, Marco Pierre White dismissed rumors that food arguments or Ramsay leaving his London restaurant caused it.
That uninvited camera crew arrival at the 2000 wedding permanently fractured the relationship between the two chefs.
That 2000 wedding remains the primary reason these two famous chefs stopped speaking to each other.
